a1.text: A gardener traces how soil, insects, trees, and rain affect one another.

a2.text: A researcher warns that ecosystems have histories and surprises unlike a maker's fixed design.

b1.text: A devotee argues that living forests cannot be reduced to gears.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A builder says analogies need not deny wonder; they only illuminate one aspect.

c1.text: They speculate about distant gardens enclosed under roofs.

c2.text: A healer asks whether a sealed garden could stay healthy without constant care.
